sources.summary: Your friendly neighbourhood superhero spins a new web of adventures, and the singer returns from Oz with her hopeful eighth album Spider-Man: Brand New Day Out now The – sequel to No Way Home maintains the focus on what’s now Spidey’s day job: protecting the city. New characters include crime boss Tombstone, played by Marvin Jones III who, like his character, is an African American with albinism. Continue reading...
